inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Empty Bloodridge sunken crypt battle stage, rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. A war torn brutal planet where everything wants to kill everything, told with absurd deadpan humour. The morning after a huge battle: craters, smoke columns, wrecked siege engines, arrows stuck in everything, old skeletons in rusted armour still frozen mid fight.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright readable war torn battle stage with absurd deadpan humour, coherent pixel clusters", "lighting": "Bright warm late afternoon sun from the upper left, cool blue shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the arena in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#5aa6e4", "#b0daf0", "#f6e4c4", "#9692c4", "#7c78aa", "#ecb050", "#b46e3c", "#56925c", "#96a0bc", "#3a3a52", "#d04a3a", "#e8e0d0"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One continuous 2.5D battle stage seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade game stage, no figures, no text. The top third is sky over a distant ridge. Along the back stands a row of ruins: an obelisk at the far left, a broken colonnade, the temple crypt in the middle with a brazier each side of its doorway, a ruined hut with ladders, a huge tree at the right, with coffins, a cart of skulls and pots in front of them. The lower two thirds is one wide open flat arena floor where two armies will stand, calm and even. A fallen column and a giant fallen statue head frame the bottom corners in shadow.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 420, 105], "desc": "a tall cracked stone obelisk bristling with arrows, a torn war banner tied to it"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [130, 55, 410, 325], "desc": "a broken colonnade, its columns full of arrows, a shredded red war banner hanging from it"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 370, 430, 635], "desc": "the sunken crypt temple, battle scarred and scorched, spears jammed in its walls, its doorway dark, two braziers still burning"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [140, 600, 420, 860], "desc": "a smashed wooden siege tower leaning on a ruined wall, thin smoke rising from it"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 790, 420, 1000], "desc": "a big half burnt tree with a shield and a helmet stuck in its branches"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [300, 250, 470, 1000], "desc": "the battle's leftovers: a toppled catapult, broken carts, heaps of shields and helmets, broken spears"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 330, 1000], "desc": "a bright late afternoon sky with tall drifting smoke columns over the long Bloodridge burial ridge on the horizon, carved with tomb terraces and dark tomb doors, the chief's stepped pyramid court on its crest"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [420, 60, 1000, 940], "desc": "a calm trampled arena of grey stone and short green grass, a few faint scorch marks, nothing busy"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [820, 0, 1000, 230], "desc": "a smoking crater rim with broken spears"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [800, 830, 1000, 1000], "desc": "a giant fallen statue head with an arrow stuck in its nose"}]}}
